name: zephyr-ai
description: Claude Code plugin and MCP server for Zephyr RTOS firmware development on STM32 and ESP32

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:ingest && npm run build:plugin-ingest
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @zephyr-ai/ingest && npm run test --workspace @zephyr-ai/mcp-server && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.check:post-build: npm run typecheck && npm run test:release && npm run quality && npm run quality:semantic && npm run quality:performance && npm run validate:plugin && npm run validate:marketplace && npm run verify:artifacts
scripts.check:quick: npm run preflight quick && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:quick && npm run validate:plugin && npm run validate:marketplace
scripts.check: npm run preflight check && npm run fetch:zephyr && npm run build:index && npm run build && npm run quality:baseline && npm run check:post-build
scripts.check:extended: npm run preflight release && npm run fetch:zephyr && npm run fetch:modules && npm run build:api-xml && npm run build:index:semantic && npm run build && npm run quality:baseline && npm run check:post-build && npm run test:skill-examples && npm run test:clean-room
